info.title: CloudWatch Metrics Fetcher
info.description: Fetches performance metrics from AWS CloudWatch

get.summary: Fetch Prometheus metrics for Kubernetes pods
get.description: Queries Prometheus for the EKS cluster. Use when checking pod CPU or memory usage, container restarts, or deployment replica availability for the boutique services.

parameters.name: metric_name
parameters.description: One of: pod_cpu_utilization (CPU cores used per pod), pod_memory_utilization (bytes per pod), pod_restarts (container restarts in the last hour), deployment_replicas_unavailable, deployment_replicas_available.

parameters.name: namespace
parameters.description: Kubernetes namespace. Use boutique for the application services (default).

parameters.name: hours_back
parameters.description: Hours of history to return as a time series. Use 1 for recent issues (default), up to 24 for trends.
